author: adrian729
scope: Eight newly authored transparent whole decorations extending the existing seven-piece set. The two initial divider terminals were revised at user request to remove painted line stubs. All original published artwork remains byte-for-byte unchanged. No historical source attribution is claimed.

assets.name: illuminated-acanthus-divider-center
assets.prompt:
Use case: style-transfer. Create ONE new transparent PNG ornament belonging to the SAME illuminated-acanthus set as the supplied original PNG references. These references are style and motif inputs, not targets to overwrite. Reference 1 is the wide headpiece, reference 2 the small upright tailpiece, reference 3 the ruled corner.
ABSOLUTE STYLE MATCH: copy their exact pigment character and craftsmanship: matte worn medium ultramarine/cobalt blue, muted brick/crimson red, warm ochre metallic gold leaf with tiny irregular flecks, sage/olive green ivy, thin dark sepia contours, ivory-white hand-painted leaf veins. Curling, scalloped broad acanthus lobes, small restrained gold scrolls, sparse pointed ivy leaves. Flat hand-painted manuscript illumination with subtle rubbed paint texture. Same restrained colors and optical stroke weight. No glossy 3D, no smooth vector finish, no photographic shadows, no jewel gemstones, no gradients or glowing halos, no new palette, no baroque carving. Nothing outside the artwork: genuinely transparent alpha in all negative space, no paper/background/drop shadow, no checkerboard painted into pixels, no lettering or labels. Keep complete tips inside canvas with only modest transparent padding; make ornament large enough for detailed native pixels. Match this specific set rather than generic medieval clipart.
Requested asset: ONE small, compact lozenge-shaped floral CENTERPIECE for a flexible horizontal divider, approximately twice as wide as tall, NO horizontal stems, NO rules, NO end-caps or spear terminals. Interlaced blue acanthus curls on the left and right, a small upward crimson leaf, two warm gold lower lobes and one tiny downward sage ivy point, tightly gathered at a gold central knot. This must be simpler, smaller and lower than the existing tall tailpiece or wide headpiece: only five principal lobes. Organic hand-drawn balance; fine slender irregular sepia outlines, NOT thick dark cartoon outlines. Broad flat curling leaves with thin scratched ivory veins and worn paint identical to the references. Solid small gold center on the exact canvas midline so a thin line may sit behind it. Almost fill a landscape canvas with just 6% transparent margins. True alpha cutout with transparent holes, no colored outer haze. Only this single compact motif.
assets.processing: Original generated PNG copied byte-for-byte to native input and master. Normal selected builds supply lossless WebP and 128/256/512/768 variants directly from the native master, without upscaling or repainting.

notes: Compact balanced five-lobe center; original blue/red/gold/ivy palette, fine veins and worn pigment retained. Reviewed at native size and as a small section-divider center.
review.user_visual_review_note: User approved the expanded set and requested production readiness and commits after reviewing the corrected terminals and additional pieces.

revisions.edit_prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the supplied transparent LEFT divider terminal PNG.
Make exactly one small correction: ERASE the short horizontal rectangular RED-AND-GOLD STRIP that projects to the RIGHT of the small three-lobed gold cap. Replace that entire straight strip, including its dark top/bottom outlines, with true alpha transparency. Leave the gold cap intact, closing its existing round/scalloped right edge cleanly so it ends as a self-contained gold trefoil finial. There must be NO horizontal stub, shaft, colored line, or fringe extending rightward from the gold cap.
Preserve the remainder of this exact ornament: the upright blue acanthus leaf, red lower leaf, gold scrolls, green ivy, ivory veins, all textures, colors, shape, position, original orientation, relative scale and existing transparent background. Keep the same 1448 by 1086 canvas with the same artwork registration and margins; do not center, crop, enlarge, move or redraw the ornament. Do not add anything. Output one transparent PNG.
revisions.note: Reference-guided edited output; non-target pixels are not claimed to be pixel-exact.
